statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT code 93226) was ordered
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
The service is medically necessary for diagnosis of the documented cardiac symptoms
The claim was denied based on reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
